How OC Revisions can be done even After PSN/ASN Creation- OC Revision restriction after Saved ASN: 356333
How OC Revisions can be done even After PSN/ASN Creation- OC Revision restriction after Saved ASN: 356333

###### Table of Contents
1. Business Requirement 2
3. Solution 2
4. Acceptance Criteria 3

## Objective

## We require a restriction on OC revisions after a Saved ASN, similar to the existing restriction that applies once an ASN is Confirmed.

## 2. Current System Behaviour
Currently the OC revision is restricted after ASN Confirmation only.

## 3. Business Requirement
We propose introducing an internal setting or a Martex-specific validation to restrict editing of Sales Orders once an ASN is saved.
At Martex, a “Saved ASN” is effectively treated as a Confirmed ASN. However, ASN confirmation is deferred until all customs and supporting documents are collected. In the meantime, they rely on reports that include both Saved and Confirmed ASNs for document verification purposes.
Given this process, the system should restrict any edits to the Sales Order after an ASN is saved to ensure data consistency and avoid discrepancies.
Currently the given validation comes on revising the Summary OC.
